geometry_note: Natural-orbital quantities (natural_occupations_full, N_D, f_e, nd_contributions, entropy_values_noon, M_fractional) are the corrected compact def2-SVP geometry values (Bohr-as-Angstrom units fix, 2026-06); N_D here reproduces Table 1. The MO-derived gap/entanglement fields (F_bond, O_MOS, S_E_max, eps_HOMO, eps_LUMO, entropy_values) retain ORIGINAL-geometry values, are superseded, belong to the separate F_bond gap-entanglement analysis, and are NOT used in the N_D paper. Canonical N_D reproducibility file: example_output/fbond_results_combined.json.
